summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of BHMR Studios one-page POC (Next.js dev server via preview URL). PRIMARY GOAL VERIFIED: no runtime error overlay and zero uncaught page errors / console errors on load and through full top-to-bottom scroll at 1920x800, 1920x1080 and 390x844; grep confirms no 'tertiary'/'secondary' references remain in src/. Verified hero scene (headline, orange disc, media plate, floating card, rotating badge), custom cursor (visibility, tracking, link scale 1.7x, media 'View' fill 2.4x + html.bhmr-cursor-on), scroll choreography (differential transforms on headline vs disc), Beliefs giant outline horizontal scrub, Address floating shapes, pinned Statement flip (white -> rgb(10,10,10), words -> rgb(246,245,242)), pinned horizontal Process timeline (track x 0 -> -1512px, counter 01 -> 07), CTA dark bg with light-streak image loaded (naturalWidth 1264) + CTA button + oversized footer wordmark, mobile 390 (scrollWidth exactly 390, statement mobile fallback white bg/ink words fully opaque, process vertical list with 7 stages, mobile sheet opens and navigates then closes), and prefers-reduced-motion (headline opacity 1, all sections visible, cursor disabled).

ui_bugs.issue: Serif-italic hero line 'worse product' is clipped by its line mask: mask clientHeight 144 vs scrollHeight 156 (12px cut), so italic descenders (p) get shaved. padding-bottom:0.12em in globals.css is not enough for the DM Serif italic line-height. All sans lines measured 0 clipping.
Console warning: next/image with 'fill' has parent with invalid position 'static' (Parallax wrapper 'h-full w-full' lacks relative). Image renders but layout is not guaranteed.

issues: Decorative giant outline wordmark ('BHMR®' / 'BELIEFS') overlaps the accent rule and the eyebrow line ('02 — WHAT WE BELIEVE'), producing a text-on-text collision at small widths
An orange FloatingShape dot sits directly on top of the Beliefs eyebrow text
Stage cards are vertically centred with differing heights, so stage labels sit at four different vertical positions — reads as accidental misalignment rather than a rhythm; consider items-start

action_items: Increase .bhmr-line-mask bottom padding (or per-face padding for .bhmr-serif-italic lines) so italic descenders are not clipped in the hero headline
Add 'relative' to the Parallax wrapper in AddressSection so next/image fill has a positioned parent (removes console warning)
Mobile: reduce/offset decorative outline wordmark + floating dot in Statement/Beliefs to avoid overlapping eyebrow text and accent rule
Optional: align Process horizontal stage cards to the top for a cleaner row
critical_code_review_comments: Reported runtime error (hero.media.tertiary.src) is confirmed gone — Hero.tsx only reads hero.media.primary/card, both defined in content/home.ts; nothing else in src/ references tertiary/secondary.
StatementSection computed initial background is rgb(255,255,255) (not #f6f5f2) — bg-paper token appears to resolve to white here; harmless but worth confirming the token is intended.
Navigation and Footer had no data-testid attributes; added minimal ones (see updated_files). Process progress counter also had no testid.
CTA h2 falls back to a single-unit fade because splitIntoLineMasks returns null for its markup (masks count 0) — motion inconsistency vs other headings, not an error.
updated_files: /app/src/components/layout/Navigation.tsx (added data-testid: site-header, nav-link-*, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu-panel, mobile-nav-link-*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: No backend. Test via preview URL only. Useful testids: hero-section, hero-orange-disc, hero-media-plate, hero-floating-card, hero-rotating-badge, hero-cta-primary/ghost, custom-cursor-dot/ring, address-section, beliefs-section, statement-section, process-section, process-progress-counter (added), cta-section, cta-button, site-header, nav-link-{address|beliefs|process}, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu-panel. GSAP state must be asserted via computed styles/transforms, not visual playback. Note: headless Chromium reports pointer:fine even at 390px, so html.bhmr-cursor-on is present on mobile emulation — not a bug. Below-fold next/image entries can report naturalWidth 0 until scrolled into view; re-check after full scroll.
rca_of_the_issue: The reported 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading src)' was stale hot-reload output referencing the pre-rewrite hero.media.tertiary. Current Hero.tsx reads only hero.media.primary.src and hero.media.card.src, both present in src/content/home.ts, and a full grep for tertiary/secondary in src/ returns nothing. Three independent page loads (desktop, mobile, reduced-motion) with pageerror/console listeners produced zero errors, confirming the error no longer reproduces.
